response.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005;

assumptions.assumption: "High-rebate" means rebrate is strictly greater than 0.0005. Rows with a NULL rebrate are excluded by the filter.

Net fee rate is computed per row as feerate - rebrate. AVG skips rows where either operand is NULL, and SUM skips NULL rebtotal values. If no rows qualify, both results are NULL, which is the required empty output.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is inclusive, so rows with rebrate equal to 0.0005 also count as high-rebate.
alternatives.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005;
